portal_hypertension.title: Suspected Khat-associated Cirrhosis: Clinical Characteristics of a 28-patient Case Series from a Khat-endemic Region.
portal_hypertension.authors: Someili A, Mohrag M, Hakami K
portal_hypertension.zhSummary: 该文聚焦门静脉高压症，属于临床研究。核心观点：我们的目的是描述阿拉伯茶流行地区疑似阿拉伯茶相关肝硬化患者的临床特征。 临床提示：卡塔叶 (Catha edulis) 在东非和阿拉伯半岛的部分地区被广泛消费。
portal_hypertension.abstract: Khat (Catha edulis) is widely consumed in parts of East Africa and the Arabian Peninsula. Although khat-related liver injury has been described, data on the clinical presentation of cirrhosis in patients with chronic khat exposure remain limited. We aimed to describe the clinical characteristics of patients with suspected khat-associated cirrhosis in a khat-endemic region. We conducted a retrospective case series at a tertiary referral center in southern Saudi Arabia between January 2020 and December 2024.
